WELCOME TO R.K. ENTERPRISES — YOUR UNIFORM FABRIC PARTNER

R.K. Enterprises is a Kolkata-based supplier of premium uniform fabrics for schools, hospitals, corporate organisations, industrial teams and security services. We focus on quality fabric options, reliable service and customised support for business requirements. Whether you are sourcing for a new uniform programme or replenishing an existing range, contact us to discuss fabric type, shade, quantity and specifications.

Our approach is built around premium quality fabric, pan-India distribution, an extensive product range, integrity and transparent pricing. We welcome institutional, commercial, dealer and bulk fabric enquiries.

Before you enquire

Fabric Sourcing FAQs.

Have these details ready if you can. It helps us understand your requirement faster.

What should I include in a fabric enquiry? ＋

Share the intended use, fabric type if known, shade or pattern, approximate quantity, location and target timeline.

Can I ask about composition, width or GSM? ＋

Yes. Mention the specification you need and our team can confirm the relevant details for the available fabric options.

Can I enquire about a particular shade or existing uniform? ＋

Yes. Include a shade name, reference image or description in the enquiry. Availability and matching options must be confirmed by the team.

Does this website accept online orders or payments? ＋

No. This is a B2B enquiry website. There is no cart, checkout or online payment. The enquiry form prepares an email for you to review and send.
